resources.string:
Be first across the line after the chosen number of laps.

You only control the throttle. Hold your pad to speed up and let go to brake. The skill is braking before a bend: a car that goes too fast in a bend leaves the slot, loses all its speed and lies off the track for a moment before it is put back.

The amber signs show the bends that need slowing down for. The grip bar above your pad fills as you near the limit; keep it out of the hatched zone in a bend.

Everyone drives at the same time, each with their own pad. Slow motion runs the race at half speed. Step by step turns it turn-based: choose throttle or coast for the next half second, press Go, and the cars run that step. With a screen reader on, each pad is an on/off switch.
Get ready. The lights count down.
Go! Hold your pad to speed up and let go before the bends.
Plan the next half second: choose throttle or coast, then press Go.
The other drivers left the race.
%1$s left the slot and is being put back.
You left the slot! You are being put back.
Ease off! A bend is coming.
Full throttle, the way is clear.
The other drivers left, so the race cannot go on.
Grip use %1$d percent. Near 100 and the car leaves the slot.
Throttle pad for %1$s. Hold to accelerate, let go to brake.
Throttle switch for %1$s. Double tap to turn the throttle on or off.
